Ugmul’s 5.5e Automation

Module v0.8.1Foundry v14D&D5e 6.0.5+

Bring the books to life.
Keep the game moving.

30+ Region and aura configurations. 100+ creature-effect automations. Ready for your table. From a spell’s first saving throw to a monster’s last grapple, Ugmul’s 5.5e Automation keeps the follow-through moving: repeat saves, ongoing damage, conditions, and escape prompts arrive when they matter. Built-in libraries come configured for supported Player’s Handbook and Monster Manual features, using the books’ native Foundry items and effects. Use the defaults, adjust them for your table, create your own, or disable any recipe. Spend less time remembering what happens next—and more time playing it.

One connected workflow, from cast to cleanup. The heart of the module is its integrated spell and feature handling. Instead of attaching a separate automation macro to every item, Ugmul’s 5.5e Automation coordinates supported attacks, spells, saves, damage, and effects through Foundry’s native workflow. Those steps can run in a deliberate order, reducing repeated roll prompts and bookkeeping as turns cycle. Bringing that work together also helps avoid overlapping processing and delays when several independent automation modules or item macros respond to the same action—keeping the game moving for players and GMs.

Discover what’s new in v0.8.1 →

I.Ready-to-use libraries

Open the books.
Skip the setup.

  • Start with a library, not a blank page. Built-in Region and creature-effect recipes cover supported spells and monster features from the Player’s Handbook and Monster Manual.
  • Make the defaults yours. Override a recipe, adjust its behavior, restore the default, or switch it off. Your local changes stay yours when the module updates.
  • Build beyond the books. Add your own spell areas and creature triggers, with source selection, searchable libraries, and editable options.

Explore the automation libraries →

II.30+ Regions & auras

Let the area
remember the rules.

  • Step into the action. Spell areas prompt configured saves, damage, and effects when creatures enter, move through, or take their turns inside.
  • Keep the magic with its source. Attached emanations follow their tokens. Flaming Sphere and Guardian of Faith gain areas that work with their summoned creatures.
  • Keep lingering effects connected. Track affected creatures and let supported concentration and Region cleanup handle the follow-through.

Explore spell Regions →

III.100+ creature-effect automations

The bite is just
the beginning.

  • Remember the next save. Poisoned, frightened, paralyzed, or incapacitated? Supported effects prompt repeat saves at the right time and clear after a successful result.
  • Give players a way out. Optional escape actions use the originating monster’s DC. Linked conditions end together, while other creatures’ effects stay in place.
  • Let monsters leave a mark. Ongoing damage, hidden monster auras, infernal wounds, and swallowing follow their own timing. Swallowed creatures take internal damage without also taking their captor’s external aura.

Explore monster automation →

IV.Class features & spells

Your next move.
Right in the roll.

  • One Paladin aura, many benefits. Combine supported class and oath benefits in one growing aura, with Genie resistance choices and Regions-layer outlines.
  • Bring Artificer tools into the roll. Flash of Genius, destructive Arcane Jolt and Arcane Firearm join the native workflow.
  • Choose your Smite. Separate spell and level selectors keep Smites easy to choose, with their damage in the weapon roll and a save card only when needed.
  • Bring your features together. Metamagic, maneuvers, Inspiration, and eligible bonus damage appear where you attack, cast, and roll damage.
  • Follow through with Cleave. Launch the extra attack from a successful hit’s chat card. Pick a different target and keep the right weapon and feature bonuses.

Explore class and spell automation →

V.Corrections & reactions

Keep the roll.
Correct the result.

  • Keep your original dice. Switch supported rolls between Advantage, Normal, and Disadvantage, or damage between Normal and Critical, without starting over.
  • React from the card. Use eligible Shield, Parry, and Inspiration options where the attack or damage appears.
  • Give reactions room to happen. Choose manual application when the table needs time to react. Undo tracked damage or effects before making a correction and applying again.

Explore roll controls →

VI.Your table, your settings

Less bookkeeping.
More control.

  • Choose the pace. Enable automatic damage, healing, and effects independently, or use manual card controls. Each table can choose how much help it wants.
  • Finish the fight cleanly. Clear inactive applied effects after combat or from the character window menu, preserving disabled class/item features and active effects.
  • Keep the turn moving. Improved turn processing, connected save prompts, and coordinated dice animations keep supported workflows moving together.

Explore application and Undo →

VII.Characters & spellbooks

Build the hero.
Fill the spellbook.

  • Start with the essentials. Guided character creation brings ability scores, native class/background/species choices, equipment, and spells into one flow.
  • Select several spells at once. Add Spell opens class-filtered results with a selection panel. Check your choices and add them together without dragging.
  • Load the spells you can prepare. For full-list casters such as Clerics and Druids, Add Spell offers to load missing available spells, ready for preparation.
  • Keep your sources in view. Use your enabled content and Foundry’s native advancement choices to build the character you want to play.

Before you install

Sources, compatibility
and installation.

Built around official content for Foundry VTT

This module enhances and automates the skills, class features, feats, and spells supplied by official Wizards of the Coast content for Foundry VTT, featured in the official Foundry VTT Marketplace. Supported sources include, but are not limited to, the Player’s Handbook and Monster Manual, with built-in defaults for the supported features described here. It builds on those items’ native activities, effects, and rolls. The books and their content are separate purchases and are not included with this module.

Compatibility matters

Designed for the native D&D5e workflow. This module is not compatible with many other automation systems, including Midi-QOL, or the automation macros attached to items brought in through D&D Beyond Importer. Avoid combining those automations with this module on the same items and rolls.

Most enhancements use the system’s standard attack, save, and damage cards. Modules or macros that replace or significantly modify those core cards can change or interrupt automated effects, prompts, and result updates. Imported items may also need their activities and effects adjusted to match the official content.

Required modules

Install and enable Automated Conditions 5e (AC5E) and Dice So Nice! alongside Ugmul’s 5.5e Automation. Both are required for the supported automation workflow and are listed as dependencies when installing the module.

In development · manual installation

5.5e Automation is still in development and is not yet listed in the Foundry VTT package directory. Install it from Foundry’s Setup screen: Add-on Modules → Install Module, paste the manifest link from Module resources into Manifest URL, then select Install. Once installed, Foundry can track the module and check for updates through that manifest.
